message.subject: Portfolio gap for ISA Sign Expo?
message.body:
Hi [Name],

Saw GSG is at ISA Sign Expo in a few weeks (Booth #3325) and noticed you're already promoting protective films through your RTape partnerships.

I'm curious if you've identified a gap in the premium segment—where your sign manufacturer customers deal with the most warranty headaches from UV damage and graffiti on outdoor installs. We work with distributors who've found adding a higher-end protective film helps them win those quality-focused accounts and reduce the service escalations that come back through their teams.

Worth a quick conversation before the show? I can share how other distributors have positioned this in their portfolio.

Best,
[Your name]
